scenario: Two engines coexist without sharing working memory: each has its own (RARC.3.2.3), and separate engines are independent (RARC.6.2.1), so facts asserted in engine A do not appear in engine B. Named for the RARC.2.4 heading (process-boundary tradeoffs), which it does not test.

engine_a.rules_ds:
schema Signal scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Int mutable

rule alert_r:
    Signal s where s.val > 10
->
    log info "alert: {s.entity_id}"

engine_b.rules_ds:
schema Signal scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Int mutable

rule alert_r:
    Signal s where s.val > 10
->
    log info "alert: {s.entity_id}"
